text: Level two, question three: a train passes a pole in nine seconds and a one hundred and eighty metre platform in twenty-one seconds; find its length and its speed in kilometres per hour. Question four: trains of one hundred and forty and one hundred and sixty metres run in opposite directions at fifty and fifty-eight kilometres per hour; how long do they take to cross each other? Question five: a two hundred metre train at sixty-three kilometres per hour overtakes a man walking at three kilometres per hour in the same direction; how long does it take to pass him?
